supplements.title: Urea cycle dysregulation and arginine pathways in the pathogenesis of NAFLD and NASH (Review).
supplements.summary: Restoring urea cycle function and arginine metabolism through supplementation may help treat fatty liver disease and its severe form.

supplements.title: Icariin from Epimedium: A Multi-Target Natural Flavonoid and Its Multi-Disease Therapeutic Potential.
supplements.summary: Icariin, a natural compound from Epimedium herb, shows promise against cancer and multiple diseases through anti-inflammatory and antitumor effects.

supplements.title: Quercetin suppresses the progression of HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma by modulating the EGFR signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Quercetin, a plant compound, slows hepatocellular carcinoma growth by blocking a key cancer-promoting pathway.

supplements.title: Evaluation of the TiaoShenZhiAi Regimen for Patients With Ovarian Cancer Experiencing a Psychoneurological Symptom Cluster: Protocol for a Multicenter, Double-Blind, Randomized Controlled Trial.
supplements.summary: A Chinese herbal treatment is being tested to relieve psychological and neurological symptoms in ovarian cancer patients.

supplements.title: Integrated network pharmacology reveal new key curcumin-binding targets in triple-negative breast cancer.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified new molecular targets where curcumin binds in triple-negative breast cancer, potentially revealing effective treatment mechanisms.

supplements.title: Significance of GSH and H2S regulation for cancer: an intricate interplay between diet, microbiota, metabolic reprogramming, and immune health.
supplements.summary: Cancer cells overproduce protective molecules GSH and H2S to survive stress, offering potential targets for new treatment strategies.

supplements.title: Prediction of molecular targets for zedoary turmeric oil in inhibiting proliferation and inducing apoptosis in non‑small cell lung cancer.
supplements.summary: Zedoary turmeric oil inhibits non-small cell lung cancer growth by targeting the EGFR/PI3K/Akt signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Urea cycle dysregulation and arginine pathways in the pathogenesis of NAFLD and NASH (Review).
supplements.summary: Restoring urea cycle function and arginine metabolism through supplementation could treat fatty liver disease by reducing inflammation and improving liver health.

supplements.title: Plant‑derived natural products alleviate dexamethasone‑induced skeletal muscle atrophy by modulating FoxO (Review).
supplements.summary: Plant-derived compounds protect against steroid-induced muscle atrophy by regulating the FoxO protein through multiple cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Fisetin Modulates Chemoresistance-Associated miR-21, miR-181a, miR-203, miR-101 and miR-381 in Capecitabine-Resistant HT29 Colorectal Cancer Cells.
supplements.summary: Fisetin, a natural compound, reverses drug resistance in colorectal cancer by altering five microRNAs that control chemotherapy response.

supplements.title: Antimalarial compounds from Solanum nigrum: In vitro antiplasmodial evaluation and network pharmacology-based investigation of host immunomodulatory mechanisms.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified antimalarial compounds in Solanum nigrum plant and analyzed how they work against malaria parasites using network analysis.

supplements.title: Multi-target mechanisms of Banxia Baizhu Tianma Decoction against MASH in a methionine-choline deficient mouse model: insights from a Multi-Omics Investigation.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese herbal formula reduced liver damage in mice with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis through multiple biological pathways.

supplements.title: A study on the network pharmacology of HQGZWWT that prevents CINP by inhibiting ferroptosis through regulation of the p38/c-FOS/NF-kB pathway.
supplements.summary: A traditional herbal formula reduces chemotherapy-induced nerve pain by blocking a cellular damage pathway related to iron buildup.

supplements.title: Characterization of an Endophytic Fusarium odoratissimum Strain 25# from Dysosma versipellis with Putative Podophyllotoxin Production.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified a fungal strain that produces podophyllotoxin, a compound used to treat lymphoma, lung cancer, and leukemia, offering a sustainable alternative to endangered plant sources.

supplements.title: A pH-responsive hydrogel based on polysaccharides incorporated with honeysuckle-derived exosome-like nanovesicles for the management of infected wound.
supplements.summary: A honeysuckle-derived hydrogel gel kills bacteria, reduces inflammation, and promotes healing in infected wounds.

off_label.title: LPAR4 mediates resistance to interferon-induced stress in soft tissue sarcoma.
off_label.summary: CDK4/6 inhibitor triggers immune responses in soft tissue sarcoma, but blocking LPAR4 protein could overcome tumor resistance mechanisms.

off_label.title: Salvage tacrolimus therapy for steroid-refractory immune-related adverse event-associated sclerosing cholangitis.
off_label.summary: Tacrolimus successfully treated a cervical cancer patient's steroid-resistant immune-related liver inflammation caused by immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Drug repurposing in KRAS G12C-mutant NSCLC: a focus on resistance mechanisms and clinical strategies.
off_label.summary: Researchers propose repurposing FDA-approved drugs to overcome resistance in KRAS G12C lung cancer, offering combination therapy strategies.

off_label.title: Romosozumab for cancer treatment-induced bone loss in postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive breast cancer: a case series.
off_label.summary: Romosozumab improved bone strength in postmenopausal women with breast cancer experiencing treatment-related bone loss, without safety concerns observed.

off_label.title: Cannabinoids and opioid consumption in cancer pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
off_label.summary: Cannabinoids may help cancer patients reduce opioid use for pain management, though more evidence is needed.

off_label.title: Phase 1/2 Study Of IL15-Transduced, TGFBR2 KO, TROP2 CAR- Engineered Cord Blood-Derived NK Cells Administered Intraperitoneally And Intravenously In Combination With Oral Belzutifan For The Management Of Pancreatic Cancer
off_label.summary: Engineered immune cells combined with a drug show promise against advanced pancreatic cancer in early clinical trials.

off_label.title: Single-nucleus interrogation of primate small intestinal aging reveals NCoR1 decline as a conserved feature that is reversed by metformin.
off_label.summary: Metformin reverses age-related intestinal decline by restoring NCoR1 protein levels in primates and human cells.

off_label.title: The O‑GlcNAcase inhibition by Thiamet G disrupts the AngioMatrix signature of the Glioblastoma secretome in silico and impairs its angiogenic capacity in vitro.
off_label.summary: Thiamet G inhibitor reduces glioblastoma's ability to promote blood vessel formation, a potential new treatment strategy.

off_label.title: Fluoxetine-associated adverse event signals with a focus on seizure: A study based on the FAERS database, network pharmacology, and molecular docking.
off_label.summary: Fluoxetine, an antidepressant, shows increased seizure risk as a side effect based on FDA safety reports and molecular analysis.

off_label.title: Gut microbial metabolism of Flutamide attenuates its therapeutic efficacy against prostate cancer.
off_label.summary: Gut bacteria break down the prostate cancer drug Flutamide into inactive forms, reducing its effectiveness and suggesting personalized treatment approaches.

off_label.title: The metabolic plasticity of cancer stem cells: bidirectional crosstalk with organ-resident cells.
off_label.summary: Cancer stem cells adapt their metabolism through interactions with surrounding tissue cells, which could be targeted to overcome treatment resistance.

off_label.title: Repurposing ALK Inhibitors as Influenza and Corona Virus Antivirals Targeting Lymphocyte Tyrosine Kinase (LTK).
off_label.summary: Existing cancer drugs that inhibit ALK show promise as antivirals against influenza and COVID-19 by targeting a host cell protein viruses need.

off_label.title: Orbital Myiasis Secondary to Neglected Medial Canthal Basal Cell Carcinoma Caused by Chrysomya bezziana.
off_label.summary: Untreated basal cell carcinoma of the eye allowed fly larvae to infest the orbit, successfully treated with larvae removal, antibiotics, and ivermectin.

off_label.title: Attenuation of ABCG2-dependent drug efflux by befotertinib restores chemosensitivity in multidrug-resistant non-small cell lung cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Befotertinib, an EGFR inhibitor, restores chemotherapy effectiveness in drug-resistant lung cancer by blocking a protein that pumps drugs out of tumor cells.

off_label.title: DPP-4 inhibitor alleviates gut-brain axis pathology in Parkinson's disease.
off_label.summary: DPP-4 inhibitor drugs reduce Parkinson's disease symptoms by blocking harmful protein transmission from the gut to the brain.

biomarkers.title: Colonic Perineurioma Presenting as a Small Subepithelial Lesion With Distinctive Endoscopic Findings.
biomarkers.summary: Doctors identified a rare benign colon tumor (perineurioma) in a 59-year-old man through colonoscopy and confirmed it with tissue analysis.

biomarkers.title: Intratumor Lactobacillus drives ferroptosis resistance via D-lactate-STAT3 K631 lactylation in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Lactobacillus bacteria in esophageal tumors produce D-lactate, which activates STAT3 proteins to help cancer cells resist ferroptosis-induced death.

biomarkers.title: FTL008.16, a 5T4-Conditional 4-1BB bispecific antibody, potently enhances antitumor immunity via tumor-directed t-cell activation.
biomarkers.summary: FTL008.16, a new bispecific antibody, safely activates immune cells specifically at tumors to fight cancer while avoiding the liver toxicity of standard 4-1BB treatments.

biomarkers.title: Predictive value of EGFR amplification and EGFRvIII mutation in EGFR-targeted therapy for recurrent glioblastoma: a systematic review.
biomarkers.summary: EGFR gene changes may help predict which patients with recurrent glioblastoma will respond to EGFR-targeted drugs, though evidence remains unclear.

biomarkers.title: RBMS1 enhances PDPK1 mRNA stability to promote multiple myeloma malignancy and M2 macrophage polarization.
biomarkers.summary: RBMS1 protein promotes multiple myeloma growth by stabilizing PDPK1 mRNA and activating cancer-supporting signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Discovery of a novel and potent KRASG12V-targeting peptide with antiproliferative activity against colorectal cancer cells.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered a peptide that selectively targets a mutated KRAS protein in colorectal cancer cells, stopping their growth effectively.

biomarkers.title: MAGED4 promotes hepatocellular carcinoma progression via activation of JAK2/STAT3 pathway by stabilizing TRIM21.
biomarkers.summary: MAGED4 protein promotes liver cancer growth by stabilizing another protein that activates a cancer-driving signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: Patients with Favorable Prognosis among Those Selected for Liver Resection for Intermediate-Stage Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified which hepatocellular carcinoma patients have the best survival chances when selected for liver surgery.

biomarkers.title: A homozygous CTLA-4 variant causes CTLA-4 deficiency with severe immune dysregulation.
biomarkers.summary: A genetic CTLA-4 deficiency causes severe immune dysfunction in a patient, treatable with abatacept therapy.

biomarkers.title: Met-Vision reveals coexisting energetic states in tissue macrophages redistributed by inflammation.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed Met-Vision to show that tissue macrophages exist in multiple distinct metabolic states, which inflammation and nitric oxide redistribute, offering new targets for cancer therapy.

biomarkers.title: A fibroblast activation protein degrader enhances cisplatin sensitivity in non‑small cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A new drug that breaks down fibroblast activation protein makes lung cancer cells more sensitive to cisplatin chemotherapy.

biomarkers.title: Urea cycle dysregulation and arginine pathways in the pathogenesis of NAFLD and NASH (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Restoring urea cycle function and arginine metabolism through supplementation may help treat fatty liver disease and its severe form.

biomarkers.title: Clinical Spectrum of Anti-SEZ6L2 Syndrome: A Case Report With Brain Volumetry and Systematic Literature Review.
biomarkers.summary: Anti-SEZ6L2 antibodies cause rare immune-mediated cerebellar disease; brain imaging and treatment outcomes were systematically reviewed.

biomarkers.title: Nonclassic congenital adrenal hyperplasia and bilateral pheochromocytomas in a patient with a germline pathogenic MAX variant.
biomarkers.summary: A patient with a germline MAX gene mutation developed both bilateral adrenal tumors and congenital adrenal hyperplasia, requiring surgical removal.

biomarkers.title: LARP1 integrates MYC and mTOR signaling to enable anabolic growth during tumor initiation.
biomarkers.summary: LARP1 protein connects MYC and mTOR signals to enable colorectal cancer initiation by controlling when cells translate growth-promoting genes.

trials.summary: FTL008.16, a new bispecific antibody, safely activates immune cells specifically at tumors to fight cancer while avoiding the liver toxicity of standard 4-1BB treatments.

trials.title: Predictive value of EGFR amplification and EGFRvIII mutation in EGFR-targeted therapy for recurrent glioblastoma: a systematic review.
trials.summary: EGFR gene changes may help predict which patients with recurrent glioblastoma will respond to EGFR-targeted drugs, though evidence remains unclear.

trials.title: Patients with Favorable Prognosis among Those Selected for Liver Resection for Intermediate-Stage Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
trials.summary: Researchers identified which hepatocellular carcinoma patients have the best survival chances when selected for liver surgery.

trials.title: A homozygous CTLA-4 variant causes CTLA-4 deficiency with severe immune dysregulation.
trials.summary: A genetic CTLA-4 deficiency causes severe immune dysfunction in a patient, treatable with abatacept therapy.

trials.title: Clinical Spectrum of Anti-SEZ6L2 Syndrome: A Case Report With Brain Volumetry and Systematic Literature Review.
trials.summary: Anti-SEZ6L2 antibodies cause rare immune-mediated cerebellar disease; brain imaging and treatment outcomes were systematically reviewed.

trials.title: Tumor cell-intrinsic NSUN2 deficiency reprograms macrophages to sensitize non-small cell lung cancer to EGFR inhibitors by reversing immune evasion.
trials.summary: Disabling NSUN2 in lung cancer cells reverses drug resistance by reprogramming immune cells to attack tumors, restoring EGFR inhibitor effectiveness.

trials.title: Intravenous amivantamab after cetuximab failure in recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: a single-centre retrospective real-world cohort study.
trials.summary: Intravenous amivantamab shows promise for head and neck cancer patients who have failed cetuximab treatment.

trials.title: Tobemstomig, a novel bispecific antibody, preferentially blocks PD-1 and LAG-3 on CD8 TILs to expand stem-like T-cells for sustained tumor control.
trials.summary: Tobemstomig, a new dual-blocking antibody, simultaneously targets PD-1 and LAG-3 on tumor-fighting CD8 cells while preserving beneficial stem-like T-cells for sustained tumor control.

trials.title: Long-term Oncologic Outcomes After Unplanned Soft Tissue Sarcoma Surgery: Implications for Surveillance Strategies.
trials.summary: Soft tissue sarcoma patients who underwent unplanned surgery face unclear long-term survival risks, requiring better follow-up strategies.

trials.title: Membrane Fusion-Mediated Cytosolic Delivery of Threose Nucleic Acids via Homotypic Nanoparticles Overcomes Drug Resistance in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
trials.summary: Nanoparticles coated with cancer cell membranes deliver gene-silencing drugs directly into triple-negative breast cancer cells, overcoming drug resistance and shrinking tumors.

trials.title: Self-Assembling Amphiphilic PROTACs: A Chemical Strategy for Improved EGFR-Targeted Protein Degradation.
trials.summary: Researchers developed self-assembling nanoparticles that deliver EGFR-targeting drugs more effectively to lung cancer tumors while reducing side effects.

trials.title: Targeting TMED4 enhances CD8+ T cell function and CAR T cell efficacy in solid tumors through the IRE1α-autophagy axis.
trials.summary: Blocking TMED4 protein strengthens immune T cells and CAR T cell therapy against solid tumors by boosting cell autophagy.

trials.title: ResMap: A community resource for systematic mapping of therapy-persistent residual cancer cell dependencies across contexts.
trials.summary: Researchers created ResMap, a resource identifying drug vulnerabilities in lung cancer cells that survive initial therapy, revealing nine promising treatment targets.

trials.title: Precision Nodal Staging in Intermediate-Risk Prostate Cancer: A Narrative Review of Molecular Imaging.
trials.summary: PSMA imaging and intraoperative techniques improve lymph node detection in intermediate-risk prostate cancer while reducing surgical complications.

trials.title: Surgical de-escalation in early-stage cervical cancer: current evidence and future perspectives.
trials.summary: Doctors can safely reduce extensive surgery for early-stage cervical cancer in selected patients while maintaining cure rates and improving quality of life.
